title: Anthropic 招股书显示：全机队每兆瓦推理收入一年内从 1600 万美元涨
html:
Anthropic 招股书显示：全机队每兆瓦推理收入一年内从 1600 万美元涨

Anthropic’s S-1 shows inference revenue per megawatt nearly quadrupling in a year.

“Inference revenue per megawatt went from sixteen million last year to sixty plus currently, across the entire fleet. AI model businesses scale extremely well.”

“Revenue grew 1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, compared to compute and infrastructure expenses that grew 300% during the same period.”

“How much of that is Anthropic being geniuses versus market-wide efficiency? We’re seeing GB be 50x better than Hopper.”

“They have TPU, Trainium, NVIDIA GPU and AMD GPU all online. New hardware is always more performant, but you need the software to use it. Who’s got the best software? Probably the company with the top engineers and the best model.”

# Anthropic 招股书显示：全机队每兆瓦推理收入一年内从 1600 万美元涨

Anthropic’s S-1 shows inference revenue per megawatt nearly quadrupling in a year.

“Inference revenue per megawatt went from sixteen million last year to sixty plus currently, across the entire fleet. AI model businesses scale extremely well.”

“Revenue grew 1,368% year over year for the three months ended June 30, compared to compute and infrastructure expenses that grew 300% during the same period.”

“How much of that is Anthropic being geniuses versus market-wide efficiency? We’re seeing GB be 50x better than Hopper.”

“They have TPU, Trainium, NVIDIA GPU and AMD GPU all online. New hardware is always more performant, but you need the software to use it. Who’s got the best software? Probably the company with the top engineers and the best model.”
html_zh:
Anthropic 招股书显示：全机队每兆瓦推理收入一年内从 1600 万美元涨

Anthropic 的 S-1 显示每兆瓦的推理收入在一年内几乎翻了两番。

“整个舰队的每兆瓦推理收入从去年的 1600 万增加到目前的 60 多。人工智能模型业务的规模非常大。”

“截至 6 月 30 日的三个月，收入同比增长 1,368%，而同期计算和基础设施支出增长了 300%。”

“与整个市场的效率相比，Anthropic 的天才程度有多少？我们发现 GB 比 Hopper 好 50 倍。”

“他们拥有在线的 TPU、Trainium、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU。新硬件总是性能更高，但你需要软件才能使用它。谁拥有最好的软件？可能是拥有顶级工程师和最佳模型的公司。”
summary_zh: SemiAnalysis 解读 Anthropic 招股书（S-1）：全机队每兆瓦推理收入从去年的 1600 万美元涨到目前的 6000 万美元以上，一年内接近翻两番。截至 6 月 30 日的三个月，收入同比增长 1368%，同期算力和基础设施支出只增长 300%，说明模型业务规模效应很强。SemiAnalysis 认为部分原因是行业整体效率提升，例如 GB 系列比 Hopper 好 50 倍。Anthropic 同时在用 TPU、Trainium、NVIDIA GPU 和 AMD GPU，而能把新硬件用好的关键在软件，也就是拥有顶尖工程师和最好模型的公司。
